DHTH.Panel.Title: Targets
DHTH.Picker.Title: Choose a Target
DHTH.Picker.HintSingle: No target selected. Choose one to continue.
DHTH.Picker.HintMulti: No target selected. Choose your targets, then confirm.
DHTH.Notify.NoCandidates: No valid targets available in this scene.
DHTH.Notify.ReplayFailed: Targets were set, but the action could not be re-run. Please trigger it again.
DHTH.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Target Helper
DHTH.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Prompt for a target when you use a targeted action with nothing targeted.
DHTH.Settings.PortraitIntegration.Name: Show Target Portraits
DHTH.Settings.PortraitIntegration.Hint: When a targeted action is used, raise the target's portrait in Ginzzzu's Portraits & NPC Dock and animate it. Requires that module; ignored otherwise.
DHTH.Settings.DamageNumbers.Name: Floating Damage Numbers
DHTH.Settings.DamageNumbers.Hint: Float resource changes off a target's portrait as they happen — Hit Points marked, Stress, healing. The system's own scrolling text is drawn over tokens, which are not visible in Theatre of the Mind. Requires Show Target Portraits.
DHTH.Settings.PortraitLinger.Name: Portrait Linger (seconds)
DHTH.Settings.PortraitLinger.Hint: How long a target's portrait stays up after the last damage or healing it received. Portraits you raised by hand are never closed.
DHTH.Settings.ClearTargets.Name: Clear Targets After Action
DHTH.Settings.ClearTargets.Hint: Release your targets automatically once a targeted action finishes. Damage and healing still apply to the targets already recorded on the chat card.
DHTH.Settings.MissFeedback.Name: Miss Feedback
DHTH.Settings.MissFeedback.Hint: When an attack hits none of its targets, remove the Roll Damage button from the chat card and flash a block/deflect on the target's portrait. Attacks without a target are unaffected.
